integrity: The source algorithm and sufficient theorem were inspected in the open full text, the earliest public arXiv date was verified independently, and the journal metadata lists 90C26 first. The proof is algebraic; the bundled numerical root checks are supporting replay only.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for symmetric positive-definite quadratics with spectrum in a positive compact interval and constant parameters. It does not extend the source nonlinear convergence theorem, quantify multidimensional objective oscillation, or optimize the parameters for minimum worst-case spectral radius.
title: Exact spectral stability and root geometry for Hessian-corrected heavy ball
